name: ON_CONFLICT_DO_NOTHING_NO_TARGET
description: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (no target) is a no-op on conflict

name: ON_CONFLICT_COL_DO_NOTHING
description: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(col) DO NOTHING scopes the conflict to one index

name: ON_CONFLICT_COL_DO_UPDATE
description: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(col) DO UPDATE rewrites the existing row

name: DO_UPDATE_WHERE_MATCH
description: DO UPDATE ... WHERE condition true: update is applied

name: DO_UPDATE_WHERE_FILTERED_OUT
description: DO UPDATE ... WHERE condition false: existing row is left alone

name: MULTI_COLUMN_CONFLICT_TARGET
description: ON CONFLICT(col1, col2) on a composite PK rewrites the existing row

name: DO_UPDATE_REFERENCES_EXCLUDED
description: DO UPDATE referencing excluded.col reads the proposed (rejected) row's value

name: DO_UPDATE_REFERENCES_EXISTING
description: DO UPDATE referencing the existing row's column accumulates state

name: DO_UPDATE_MIXED_EXISTING_AND_EXCLUDED
description: DO UPDATE can mix references to t.col and excluded.col in one expression

name: ON_CONFLICT_WHERE_PARTIAL_INDEX_MATCH
description: ON CONFLICT(b) WHERE b>0 targets a partial UNIQUE index and rewrites the row

name: ON_CONFLICT_WHERE_PARTIAL_INDEX_NO_MATCH
description: Partial UNIQUE index does not include negative rows; both stay

name: INSERT_OR_REPLACE_REPLACES_ROW
description: INSERT OR REPLACE rewrites the conflicting row entirely (legacy shorthand)

name: INSERT_OR_IGNORE_SKIPS_ROW
description: INSERT OR IGNORE silently skips conflicting rows (legacy shorthand)

name: REPLACE_INTO_LEGACY_FORM
description: REPLACE INTO is the legacy alias for INSERT OR REPLACE

name: ON_CONFLICT_RETURNING_UPDATED
description: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE ... RETURNING emits the updated row

name: ON_CONFLICT_RETURNING_INSERTED_ON_FRESH
description: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE ... RETURNING emits the inserted row when there is no conflict

name: MULTIPLE_ON_CONFLICT_CLAUSES
description: Two ON CONFLICT clauses for different targets pick the relevant action

name: MULTIPLE_ON_CONFLICT_PK_BRANCH
description: Two ON CONFLICT clauses: PK collision triggers the PK branch (DO NOTHING)

name: ON_CONFLICT_COLLATE_NOCASE_TARGET
description: UNIQUE index with COLLATE NOCASE: conflict target must repeat the COLLATE

name: ON_CONFLICT_UNIQUE_INDEX_TARGET
description: UNIQUE index column can be a conflict target distinct from the PK

name: MULTI_ROW_INSERT_UPSERT
description: Multi-row INSERT with UPSERT applies the action per conflicting row

name: INSERT_SELECT_UPSERT
description: INSERT ... SELECT followed by ON CONFLICT applies per source row

name: ON_CONFLICT_DEFAULTED_COLUMN
description: INSERT omits a defaulted column; conflict path overwrites b but keeps c at DEFAULT

name: ON_CONFLICT_NO_TARGET_DO_NOTHING_MIXED_BATCH
description: Untargeted ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING preserves the prior row and inserts only the fresh ones

name: ON_CONFLICT_DO_UPDATE_NO_OP_VALUES
description: DO UPDATE SET col = col is a legal no-op and leaves the row unchanged

name: ON_CONFLICT_DO_UPDATE_RETURNING_STAR
description: UPSERT with RETURNING * emits every column of the resulting row

name: INSERT_OR_REPLACE_FIRES_DELETE_THEN_INSERT
description: INSERT OR REPLACE deletes the conflicting row then inserts the new one (rowid changes)

name: ON_CONFLICT_DO_UPDATE_PRESERVES_ROWID
description: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE keeps the original rowid (unlike INSERT OR REPLACE)
